name: Cauldron Hag (Paragon Hag Archetype)
body:
Focusing on chemical admixtures rather than witchcraft, the cauldron hag approaches magic in a completely different way.

Extracts

A cauldron hag creates extracts drawn from the alchemist formula list. She must learn formulae, keep them in a formula book, and prepare them daily as an alchemist. Her family spells are added as formulas known and can be prepared as other formulas. The DC for her extracts and her bonus extracts, as well as class abilities based on Charisma, are based on Intelligence rather than Charisma.

This ability replaces spells.

Alchemical Rituals: At 1st level, the cauldron hag gains Brew Potion as a bonus feat and can use Craft (alchemy) in place of Knowledge (arcana) for occult rituals. This ability replaces cantrips.

Radiant Mutagen (Su)

At 1st level, a cauldron hag can brew a mutagen that makes her appear completely innocent. This functions as a sanctuary spell lasting 10 minutes per level and grants a +4 alchemical bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, and Disguise checks. While under the effects of this mutagen, the hag’s claws are normal nails and cannot be used in combat. If the cauldron hag attacks, the sanctuary effect is only disrupted for those who see the attack, rather than ending entirely.

This replaces the paragon hag’s 1st level family ability.

Discoveries

At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the cauldron hag gains an alchemist discovery she qualifies for. This replaces the paragon hag’s legendary family ability and the 4th, 8th, 12th, and 16th level family abilities.
